_comment: Three entries load `vendor.js` (`a`, `b` and `other.js`), but `a` loads it before it imports `other.js`, so the fold drops `other.js` from its bits. The `vendor` group, which needs three entries, then takes neither `vendor.js` nor `peer.js`, and both land in the chunk of `a` and `b`. While `vendor.js` is still in its own chunk, a fold of `shared.js` into the chunk of `a` and `b` would make the two import each other, so `shared.js` stays a file.
